competitors.name: Kroger
competitors.action: Kroger expanded its loyalty program so shoppers can redeem points directly against grocery purchases in store or online, not only fuel. The new structure gives $1 off groceries for every 100 points redeemed, capped at $10 per day, and is paired with bonus-point promotions as Kroger works to simplify its value message under CEO Greg Foran.

trends.topic: GLP-1 adoption is moving from niche health trend to measurable grocery-demand pressure
trends.magnitude: Big Chalk Analytics projects GLP-1-related food-at-home sales pressure of 1.1% to 2.7% in 2026, equal to at least $9B and potentially more than $21B, with oral formats potentially lifting active users by up to 50% by 2027.
trends.context: For Real Dough, this reinforces the need for portion, protein, satiety, and clean-ingredient cues to be concrete rather than implied. Indulgent freezer products will keep facing pressure from shoppers eating less volume and evaluating smaller portions more carefully.

market_data.metric: U.S. frozen pizza and frozen pizza crust/dough category performance
market_data.value: Frozen pizza: $7.335B and 1.394B units for the 52 weeks ending April 19, 2026, both down 2%; frozen pizza crusts/dough: $40.48M, down 6%, and 9.57M units, down 8%.
market_data.change: Category softness is broad, but pockets remain: Palermo Villa grew frozen pizza dollar sales 8%, Champion Foods grew 20%, and private-label frozen crust/dough grew 12% in dollars and 14% in units.

breaking.headline: State of the Industry 2026: Pizza innovation heats up
breaking.impact: The category is soft overall, but buyers are still rewarding distinct lanes: value, restaurant-quality cues, protein, portion control, regional styles, and cleaner labels. Real Dough should treat crust differentiation and a clear value-for-premium story as table stakes, not extras.

breaking.headline: GLP-1 use can skyrocket with new pill form
breaking.impact: Potential oral GLP-1 adoption raises the risk of lower grocery volumes and smaller package preferences. Frozen pizza brands need sharper reasons to fit smaller, more intentional eating occasions.

breaking.headline: Kroger lets shoppers redeem loyalty points for grocery savings
breaking.impact: Kroger is making grocery savings more immediate and legible. Premium frozen brands will have to defend value at shelf as major retailers lean harder into loyalty-funded price perception.
